name: com.nuverlabs/image-gen
title: Image Gen
description: Generate and edit images with Gemini and OpenAI image models using your own API keys, saved straight into your project.

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Google Gemini API key. Enables the Gemini provider. At least one provider key is required.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key. Enables the OpenAI provider. At least one provider key is required.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GEN_MCP_DEFAULT_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Provider used when a tool call does not name one: gemini or openai. Defaults to whichever key is set, preferring gemini.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GEN_MCP_GEMINI_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Default Gemini model. Defaults to gemini-3.1-flash-image.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GEN_MCP_OPENAI_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Default OpenAI model. Defaults to gpt-image-2.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GEN_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory used when a tool call passes no output_path.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GEN_MCP_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Comma separated directories that file reads and writes are confined to. Unset means unrestricted.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GEN_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout to the provider API in milliseconds. Defaults to 180000.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GEN_MCP_LOG_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path of the JSONL image ledger. Defaults to ~/.image-gen-mcp/images.jsonl. Set to none to disable the file.
